title: Revit Datum and Reference Governed Fields

entries.name: Datum/reference class
entries.requirement: Each governed datum or reference object shall identify whether it is a level, grid, scope box, reference plane, or another approved datum/reference class.

entries.name: Stable identity
entries.requirement: Each persistent governed datum/reference object shall have a stable identity sufficient to distinguish it from duplicates, temporary constructs, or ad-hoc local substitutes.

entries.name: Authoritative source
entries.requirement: Each governed level or grid, and any reference object whose position is authoritative, shall identify the applicable project datum, grid, survey/control, coordination, or other governed source from which its position or identity is derived.

entries.name: Naming basis
entries.requirement: Persistent datum/reference objects shall follow the applicable governed naming syntax or project-specific naming configuration. Source example abbreviations and patterns are not canonical unless separately approved.

entries.name: Position or elevation basis
entries.requirement: Where position or elevation is material, the datum/reference definition shall identify the governed position/elevation basis and shall not rely on unexplained local offsets or near-duplicate values.

entries.name: Cross-model alignment
entries.requirement: Where the datum/reference object is shared across disciplines or linked models, its identity and position shall remain aligned to the applicable authoritative project source or an approved recorded exception.

entries.name: Purpose and scope
entries.requirement: Scope boxes and reference planes, and other non-primary datum objects, shall declare a continuing modeling, documentation, coordination, or crop/extents purpose sufficient to justify their persistence.

entries.name: Temporary or persistent status
entries.requirement: Temporary datum/reference objects shall be distinguishable from persistent governed objects and shall be removed, retired, or otherwise resolved before the applicable issue/release gate unless an approved reason exists.

entries.name: Graphics and annotation reference
entries.requirement: Where graphical representation is governed, datum/reference graphics shall resolve through the applicable graphics, annotation, and view-template standards rather than local ad-hoc overrides.

entries.name: Change control
entries.requirement: Material changes to governed levels, grids, scope boxes, or reference planes that affect coordination or documentation shall be traceable through the applicable project or standards change-control process.

non_promoted_source_content: No source example level abbreviations, capitalization rules, level names, minimum vertical spacing, grid-axis orientation, skipped-letter set, infill rule, scope-box names, reference-plane types, or graphics values are promoted as enterprise defaults.
Project Level Matrix rows, survey/control values, authoritative grid coordinates, scope-box inventories, and reference-plane inventories remain project/configuration data.

provenance.source_title: Levels, Grids & Reference Standards - Revit Guidelines
provenance.migration_note: Promotes the durable machine-readable fields needed to govern levels, grids, scope boxes, and reference planes while preserving S6 spatial authority and leaving source examples/TODO values as configuration rather than canonical defaults.
